benchmark: XAUUSD GOLD SPOT / MULTILATERAL SOVEREIGN DISCOUNT

USD.impact_on_gold: Primary sovereign hurdle. Elevated real rates apply negative drift unless inflation surprises to the upside.

EUR.impact_on_gold: Dominates 57.6% of DXY. ECB rate cuts widen US-EU rate differential, strengthening DXY and creating temporary headwind for XAUUSD.

JPY.impact_on_gold: Deep negative real rates (-2.55%) drive massive domestic gold accumulation. Any BoJ rate hike unwinds carry trades, causing violent global gold volatility.

GBP.impact_on_gold: Sticky services inflation (3.3%) limits BoE rate cut room, providing bilateral support against dollar dominance.

CNY.impact_on_gold: World's largest physical gold buyer. PBOC continuous reserve accumulation provides structural institutional put option under XAUUSD dips.

CHF.impact_on_gold: Safe-haven currency competitor. Disinflation in Switzerland reflects global goods deflation trends.

transmission_model.formula: r_XAU = beta_0 + beta_US * Z_US + beta_EU * Z_EU + beta_JP * Z_JP + beta_CN * Z_CN + delta * Delta_Real_Rates
